intake_type: Noether source-audit control / no-patch survival and regression-trap package
decision: No new German TeX patch. Track as Batch39/RA58 survival evidence and regression-trap guardrail after the Slavic handoff.
summary: The package confirms that the current Batch39 German cumulative preserves RA58-confirmed Paper 11 repairs while avoiding one RA58 regression. The Slavic handoff is a translation/reference handoff and must not replace the German source-audit base.
confirmed_survival_loci: P11 keeps source-style symbolic footnote markers for all local notes.
P11 keeps 12 left-numbered display anchors and no tag-style display conversion.
P11 retains 25 occurrences of Omega_Gamma and zero mathfrak L_Gamma occurrences.
Formula (11) remains plain G_k/H_k with H_k sigma_k = G_k.
The Tschirnhaus footnote source trap is retained rather than normalized.
The final theorem paragraph keeps the source semicolon.
regression_traps: Do not regress varphi_3(x) to u*w/v from the prior RA58 standalone file. Best local source crop confirms the Batch39 order w*u/v.
Do not use the Slavic handoff as a newer German source-audit base.
source_caveat: Best local P11 GDZ IIIF full-page witnesses are about 400 ppi. The labelled crop supports the varphi_3 product-order locus, but this is not strict native 650+ all-glyph paper certification.
contents_summary: one labelled source crop for the varphi_3 product-order regression trap
public_caveat: This is a best-available no-patch survival/regression-control package. It is not a new TeX patch, not strict all-glyph certification, not a new reader upload, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization proof, and not a critical edition.
next_action: Use as a guardrail for future Noether rollups and web/source-audit handoffs; keep Batch39 as current German base and avoid replaying stale RA58 or Slavic-reference changes unless a concrete source-current mismatch appears.
